contact.title: A question before you try?

faq.a: You upload up to 5 photos of the vehicle, pick one of the 4 settings (neon garage, industrial hangar, underground car park, empty room) or your own background, and the AI replaces the background in seconds. It is strictly instructed not to touch the bodywork, windows, wheels or plate.

faq.q: Can I use my own background and logo?
faq.a: Yes. In the editor, choose "Your own background" and import a photo of your showroom or workshop: it is remembered. Your logo, added once in the brand kit, can be placed on every render, in the corner you choose.

faq.q: What photo quality do I need?
faq.a: A photo from a recent smartphone is plenty. Shoot in full daylight, from the front three-quarter angle, with the whole body in frame.

faq.q: Can I use the renders in my listings?
faq.a: Yes. Renders download in high resolution and can be used freely in your listings, on social media or on your website.

faq.q: Can I post these videos on social media?
faq.a: Yes. Any render can become a short presentation video in Reel, Story, landscape or square format, ready for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn or TikTok, with no editing.

faq.q: Does the render change the vehicle?
faq.a: It shouldn't: only the background is replaced, and the AI is instructed to keep the bodywork, paint, wheels, windows and plate exactly as they are. As with any listing photo, check the render before publishing: if a detail of the vehicle has moved, run the generation again or fix it with a retouch.

faq.q: Is my first render really free?
faq.a: Yes, no strings attached. Create your account, upload your photo, pick your setting and generate your first render, with no credit card and no commitment.
